GATE RECALL — START HERE

1. Extract this ENTIRE ZIP to a folder.
2. Open index.html with Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari on a computer.
3. Keep all files and folders together. Bookmark the page.
4. Choose a subject, topic and subtopic. Recall, read and practise.
5. Export progress regularly from Offline & backup.

Everything needed for local study is included. No ChatGPT account, subscription or internet is needed. External reference and community solution links require internet. Progress is stored in your browser; use Export/Import to move it.

For phones, use a hosted HTTPS copy, download study material from Offline & backup, and add it to your home screen. Check readiness before disconnecting.

See README.md for accuracy notes and GitHub Pages instructions.
